page.layout: One column of chronological entries, the years printed in the left margin beside each entry; marginal notes in the right margin. No running head, no page number at head or foot.
page.notes: Year numbers in the left margin, as printed: 1290, 1291, 1292, 1293, 1294, 1295, 1296, 1297, 1298, 1299. The entries in the text are a list of names placed beside these years and are transcribed as lines, not as running text. The year 1290 and the names with a leading ornament mark ("Andreas", "Meinoldus", "Menoldus", "Arnoldus") carry small decorative flourishes that are not letters. Left margin note beside 1290: "Frisia Geldro data ab Alberto imp." (printed "Frifia Geldro data ab Alberto imp."). Right margin note beside 1292: "Pedus civitatis Groningi, cum Drentinis de pace firmanda." (first letter printed as a decorated capital; read as "Pedus" [?]). Right margin note beside 1299: "Frisii ad occid. Flevi ab Hollando subacti, & Hollandiae additi." (printed "Frisii ad occid. Flevi ab Hollando subacti, & Hollandiæ additi.") Printed page number 7 at the head of the page is not transcribed as a page_number, because it stands above the entries as a folio number; it is recorded here: "7". The lines of the text are ruled by printed horizontal rules between the entries; these are not text. Lines in the list are partly faded at the right edge; the spelling of "Gisekinus" and "Calemari" is [?] as read.
